verdict.rationale: Logseq's architecture keeps data out of the vendor's reach by design. Syncing is opt-in per graph, so graphs can stay local only, and synced graphs are end-to-end encrypted with Age/ChaCha20-Poly1305, covering both file contents and names. The product is also positioned as privacy-first, which structurally keeps user content unreadable by Logseq for training. However, the pack has no explicit statement or control about AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or opt-out, a published privacy/data-use commitment covering AI, and independent corroboration.
